name: – Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan – § 33 – Am 24
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 33. Highlights the fact that the Commission’s assessment of the fulfilment of milestones is not sufficiently transparent but rather is political without well-defined objectives or clear standards and deadlines; recalls, in this regard, the discretionary power of the Commission; regrets the fact that, as a result, it is possible to misuse super milestones as political blackmail in certain Member States;
